answers.answer_text: ISP Assignment 3 - E007 Aayush Nayak Q1. OSI Model in Email Sending and Receiving In the OSI (Open Systems Interconnection) Model, email communication follows a specific path through the layers, with each layer contributing to efficient data exchange. Here's how email typically moves through each OSI layer: 1. Application Layer (Layer 7): This layer interacts with email applications (e.g., Gmail, Outlook) using protocols like SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) for sending and IMAP/POP3 for receiving emails. Users compose an email, and the email application prepares it for transfer over t he network. 2.
